description: The full public card for one booth: description, menu items with ticket prices where present, `products` (what the vendor sells, as the booth sheet in the app lists it), the printed aisle, public links, logo and today's offering if set. `mapless: true` means the booth has no position on the floor plan. Accepts a booth id or a booth/vendor name.

eventIdOrSlug.description: Event id (belmont_stroll), public slug (cba26), or the event NAME as events_list spells it ("Summer Stroll & Savor"). Common short forms work too ("the stroll", "tie summit").

name: events_booth_detail
title: Get one booth card
